items.text: Morning, all options
Yotsubashi Line Tamade → Daikokuchō (3 stops), exit 1, 3 min walk.
Seafood bowl at Kizu Uoichi Shokudō or another market eatery. Cash only; shops close towards 11:00.
Back to Tamade.

Free time at the stay (~1 h 15 min). Only if the second luggage option was used: collect the suitcases at Nishinari Tamade Post Office (same block; counter Mon–Fri 9:00–17:00; passport + tracking number).

Same slot, Osaka → Haneda option A (not decided): Japan Post Airport Yu-Pack at the same post office, pickup JAL ABC T3 3F on Mon 23. Ask there if parcels can wait at the airport until Mon 23. Then overnight bags only.

Afternoon: Option 1, 3 or 4, decided when the time comes. "Added" and "Missing" compare with the earlier Friday plan (free until ~16:00, Tenjinbashi 16:30, Umeda Sky ~18:15, dinner ~19:45, home ~21:15).
Option 1: old Osaka lunch, cafés, sunset (demanding)
Yotsubashi Line Tamade → Hommachi, then walk.
Pressed sushi lunch, ~¥3,000. Lunch 11:00–15:00; closed Sat, Sun and holidays, so Fri is its only possible day.
Midōsuji Line Hommachi → Umeda (~5 min), then walk to Nakazakichō (~10 min).
Pre-war lanes with the cafés open.
Tanimachi Line Nakazakichō → Minami-morimachi, then 5 min walk.
Coffee at the Tenmangu stand (takeaway; hours not confirmed).
Walk north along the arcade; snacks.
Tanimachi Line to Higashi-Umeda, then walk to Umeda Sky.
¥2,000. Sunset ~16:55, then city lights.
Walk to Fukushima.
Dinner in Fukushima. Suggestion for chicken skin: O26a Ichiya (book or check its hours).
Instead of Fukushima, decide on the fly: Kobe beef teppanyaki at LINKS UMEDA, right by Umeda Sky (L.O. 21:30, dinner from ¥12,980).
Fukushima → Tamade. Home ~20:15.
Added: O17; O11 with cafés open and 70 min instead of 30; O3 +15 min; O8 at sunset; home ~1 h 15 min earlier.
Missing: nothing from the earlier plan. We lose the free gap, and O8 is dusk rather than full night.
Option 3: Kobe beef at lunch (medium)
Yotsubashi Line Tamade → Nishi-Umeda, walk to LINKS Umeda.
Kobe beef lunch from ¥5,280. Sources conflict on "certified": check its site.
Pre-war lanes with the cafés open; ~10 min from Umeda.
Tanimachi Line Nakazakichō → Minami-morimachi, then 5 min walk.
Coffee at the Tenmangu stand (takeaway; hours not confirmed).
Walk north along the arcade; snacks.
Tanimachi Line to Higashi-Umeda, then walk to Umeda Sky.
¥2,000. Sunset ~16:55, then city lights.
Walk to Fukushima.
Dinner in Fukushima. Suggestion for chicken skin: O26a Ichiya (book or check its hours).
Fukushima → Tamade. Home ~20:15.
Added: O5 Kobe beef done, about ¥7,700 pp cheaper than dinner; O11 with cafés open; O8 at sunset; Sat 21 dinner free of the Kobe question; home ~1 h 15 min earlier.
Missing: O17 (Fri is its only possible day); the Kobe splurge as a dinner, and O5a Techangum becomes unnecessary. Beef and kushikatsu on the same day.
Option 4: Katsuō-ji (demanding)
Yotsubashi Line → Daikokuchō, Midōsuji Line → Minoh-Kayano (check the train goes all the way), Hankyu Bus 30 from stop No. 8 (~25 min, IC or exact cash). Buy onigiri on the way.
Daruma-filled mountain temple, autumn colour. Last entry 16:30; ¥500 (verify). 📿 stamp.
Bus back, Midōsuji Line → Umeda, Tanimachi Line → Minami-morimachi.
Coffee at the Tenmangu stand (takeaway; hours not confirmed).
Walk north along the arcade; snacks.
Pre-war lanes; most cafés close early.
Nakazakichō → Higashi-Umeda (Tanimachi Line, 2 min), then walk to Umeda Sky.
¥2,000; rooftop night view.
Dinner in Fukushima. Suggestion for chicken skin: O26a Ichiya (book or check its hours).
Instead of Fukushima, decide on the fly: Kobe beef teppanyaki at LINKS UMEDA, right by Umeda Sky (L.O. 21:30, dinner from ¥12,980).
Fukushima → Tamade.
Added: O22, the day's only nature and autumn colour, plus a 📿 stamp.
Missing: O17; a sit-down lunch; rest. O11 stays rushed, and O8 misses sunset. About 2 h 35 min of commuting.
